verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official client libraries in Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust, .NET and Java, plus an official MCP server that MCP-capable agent frameworks could connect to. Nothing in the pack documents first-class, maintained integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex or other RAG frameworks; the agent skills target coding assistants, not RAG pipelines. Missing for 10: documented LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations, evidence those integrations are maintained, framework-level RAG/agent examples, independent hands-on corroboration.
